description: A coroutine is a function that can suspend and resume. You are reading a commented sketch that needs a generator wrapper.

steps.description: The comments name the supporting machinery and three operations. co_yield supplies a value, co_return ends the coroutine, and co_await waits on an awaitable.
The sketched generator yields a before updating the two Fibonacci variables. Its loop describes an ongoing sequence.
The sketched caller iterates over the generator while the current value is below 100.
The coroutine frame holds local state across suspensions. This lets the next resume continue from the saved state.

title: Read a coroutine sketch
